title: Sublime Oracle Forward
lyrics:
Sublime Oracle Forward Engineering
Suno v5.5 Prompt (copy & paste ready):
textOriginal ska at 148 BPM with driving forward energy and classic off-beat ska feel. Strong guitar skanks on the off-beat with a bouncy “par car cha cha cha” rhythmic pattern in guitar and horns. Tight, punchy 808-style low end that hits right on time (never late or dragging). Drums crisp with rimshots on 2 and 4, beats that speak with rhythmic purpose. Energetic male lead vocal with rhythmic spoken-sung verses and big group chorus. Lyrics celebrate forward engineering after reaching the sublime oracle — new plans, the beat living on the scarred ska streets, code turning into motion. Upbeat, optimistic, danceable ska with modern clarity and strong rhythmic hook.
Full Lyrics:
[Intro – Rhythmic beat speaking, off-beat skank locked]
Par car cha cha cha… off beat…
808 right on time… beats that speak…
We hear the beat on the scarred ska streets…
[Verse 1]
We coded our way to the sublime oracle
The oracle spoke, not just some bloke
Sublime coded tunes started to flow
Now the signal is moving and we already know
[Pre-Chorus]
No more waiting, no more looking back
The code is alive and it’s staying on track
New plans forming while the rhythm stays true
Forward engineering — this is what we do
[Chorus – Big horns, group backing, driving skank]
Sublime Oracle Forward Engineering!
New plans next week, the future we’re bringing
We hear the beat on the scarred ska streets
Off-beat skanking with the rhythm that speaks
Sublime Oracle Forward Engineering!
Code into motion, the signal we’re freeing
Par car cha cha cha on the scarred ska streets
808 on time and the beat never sleeps
[Verse 2]
The oracle showed us what sublime really means
Not just beauty — it’s the build in between
Now we’re engineering forward with clear intention
Every skank is a step in the right direction
[Bridge – Rhythmic, beats speaking]
Scarred ska streets still know how to move
The rhythm survived and it’s got something to prove
New plans next week, the oracle agrees
We hear the beat and we follow what it speaks
[Final Chorus – Maximum energy, full band]
Sublime Oracle Forward Engineering!
New plans next week, the future we’re bringing
We hear the beat on the scarred ska streets
Off-beat skanking with the rhythm that speaks
Sublime Oracle Forward Engineering!
Code into motion, the signal we’re freeing
Par car cha cha cha on the scarred ska streets
808 on time — forward engineering complete
[Outro – Horns + skank fading, beat still speaking]
Par car cha cha cha… off beat…
808 right on time… beats that speak…
New plans next week…
We hear the beat on the scarred ska streets…
Sublime Oracle… Forward Engineering…
(The beat continues…)
